facts.text: The hotel occupies the top nine floors of the Midtown Tower in the Roppongi District of Tokyo.
facts.excerpt: Occupying the top nine floors of the 53-story Midtown Tower in the Roppongi District

facts.text: Héritage by Kei Kobayashi, the hotel's French restaurant, holds one Michelin star.

facts.text: Hinokizaka, the hotel's Japanese restaurant, has separate areas for kaiseki, sushi, tempura and teppanyaki.
facts.excerpt: Hinokizaka features four areas for each of Kaiseki, Sushi, Tempura, and Teppanyaki

facts.text: The hotel has a patisserie, Nina, run by pastry chef Nina Métayer.
facts.excerpt: A patisserie by Nina Métayer, the world-renowned pastry chef who was crowned World's Best Pastry Chef twice.

facts.text: The Bar is a cocktail bar and restaurant on the 45th floor with city skyline views.
facts.excerpt: sophisticated cocktail bar and restaurant in Tokyo on the 45th floor pairs the city skyline views with shareable plates and an extensive drink menu

facts.text: Afternoon tea at The Lobby Lounge is served on Arita porcelain.
facts.excerpt: Savor seasonal savories and exquisite sweets and pastries, meticulously crafted to reflect Japan's four seasons served on exclusive Arita porcelain.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite features Edo-Kiriko pendant lights, ebony wood flooring and a cloud-patterned carpet.
facts.excerpt: The suite features exquisite details such as Edo-Kiriko pendant lights, ebony wood flooring, and a cloud-patterned carpet.

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa is on the 46th floor and has skyline views.
facts.excerpt: on the 46th floor, The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Tokyo encourages wellness with a blend of Eastern and Western traditions.

facts.text: The spa offers ESPA treatments, Bastien Gonzalez hand and foot treatments, and Shiseido Synactif treatments.
facts.excerpt: facial and body treatments by ESPA, hand and foot treatments by Bastien Gonzalez, and Shiseido Synactif treatments.

facts.text: Hotel guests have complimentary access to the indoor pool, the fitness studio and the heat experience area.
facts.excerpt: Hotel guests have complimentary access to Indoor Pool, Fitness Studio, and Heat Experience Area.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club Lounge at our luxury Tokyo hotel with concierge services offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

facts.text: The hotel's restaurants and Club Lounge have views toward Shinjuku, the Imperial Palace or Mount Fuji.
facts.excerpt: views of the Shinjuku area, the Imperial Palace, or Mount Fuji

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the hotel as set in an actual neighborhood with many cafes and boutiques to discover during the day.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service from the airports.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary Club access.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes Mount Fuji is really only visible from the hotel on clear days with low humidity.
